purpose: Resource and deterministic-forward probe for FerretNet before any labelled elimination screen. This protocol cannot alter product scoring, thresholds, dependencies, or web behaviour.

upstream.license_evidence: Repository root LICENSE at the registered revision; the model file is tracked by that same revision.
upstream.weight_license_gate: Research-only probe is allowed because the checkpoint is tracked in the Apache-2.0 repository, but product use remains blocked until the authors explicitly confirm that the repository license grants use of the released checkpoint.

inference.input_preprocessing: official Test.yaml: CenterCrop(256), ToTensor(), Normalize(CLIP mean/std); no Grad-CAM, backward pass, CUDA, distributed setup, or automatic downloads
inference.score_semantics: sigmoid(logit) from the released checkpoint; a model output, not an AI probability

resource_probe.selection: first 12 manifest records in frozen manifest order; labels and source classes are not read into probe output or used for any decision

future_elimination_profiles.resize_longest=1024_restore: Lanczos downscale long edge to 1024 when larger, then Lanczos restore to decoded dimensions
future_elimination_profiles.screenshot_raster_png_longest=1600: Lanczos render to a maximum 1600-pixel long edge, serialize RGB PNG, then decode; a deterministic screenshot proxy, not a substitute for platform or camera recapture data

labelled_elimination_tier1.selection: all 160 frozen records in manifest order; no record may be removed after scoring
labelled_elimination_tier1.failure_policy: Failure in either profile, any generator slice, resource limit, or cross-view stability rejects FerretNet before full five-variant testing. No threshold, crop, ensemble, or augmentation may be retuned on this cohort.
